question: Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth, has been laid under ________ of the Fundamental Rights in the Constitution of India.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 15**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth is laid under Article 15 of the Constitution of India: 
 
• Article 15
 
• Prohibits discrimination against citizens based on the five protected grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
 
• It also states that citizens cannot be subject to any disability, liability, restriction, or condition based on these grounds. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other articles
 
• Other articles in the Constitution of India that ensure the Right to equality for all Indians include: 
 
• Article 14: Equality before the law 
 
• Article 16: Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment 
 
• Article 17: Abolition of untouchability 
 
• Article 18: Abolition of titles 
 
• Fundamental rights are the rights that grant individuals equality in every aspect irrespective of race, color, caste, religion, birthplace, or gender.
